title: Beef and Broccoli
description: Thin strips of flank steak seared hot and tossed with crisp-tender broccoli in a glossy garlic, ginger and oyster sauce.
scaleNote: A 12-inch skillet or wok fits 1 pound of beef in two batches. For a double batch, sear the beef in four batches and steam the broccoli in two, so the pan stays hot.
equipment: 12-inch skillet or wok with a lid

image.alt: Illustration of beef strips and broccoli on a plate beside a bowl of rice

steps.text: Slice the steak across the grain into thin strips about {len 1/4 in} thick. Toss the strips with {qty 1 tbsp} soy sauce and {qty 2 tsp} cornstarch, then set aside while you prepare everything else.
In a small bowl, whisk together the water, oyster sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar and cornstarch for the sauce until no lumps of cornstarch remain.

Heat {qty 1 tbsp} of the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Add the broccoli and stir-fry until it starts to brown in spots, {time 1 min}. Pour in {qty 1/4 cup} of water, cover and cook until bright green and just tender when pierced with a knife, {time 2-3 min}. Tip onto a plate.

Pour off any water left in the pan and set it over high heat with {qty 1 tbsp} of the oil. When the oil just starts to smoke, add half the beef in a single layer. Sear until browned underneath, {time 1-2 min}, then flip and brown the other side, {time 1 min}. Move to the plate.
Add the rest of the oil and sear the remaining beef the same way, {time 2-3 min} in all. Add it to the plate.

Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and ginger and stir until fragrant, {time 30 sec}. Whisk the sauce again, since the cornstarch settles, then pour it in and stir until it bubbles and turns thick and glossy, {time 1-2 min}.
Return the beef, broccoli and any juices from the plate to the pan. Toss until everything is coated and heated through, {time 1 min}. Serve over the rice.

notes: Flank steak slices much more easily when it is firm. Put it in the freezer for {time 15-20 min notimer} before slicing.
The safe temperature for beef steak is {temp 145F internal}. Strips this thin pass it quickly over high heat, and they finish in the simmering sauce.
Sirloin or skirt steak work in place of flank. Always slice across the grain, which keeps the strips tender.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days. The broccoli softens on reheating but the flavor holds up.
